  id = {EDN-03},
  title = {The Spanish listings are held out as the new-market scenario},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-40} (2026-09-30): the holdout is selected per listing.},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M1: Project Inception},

  participants = {@lukas2510, after supervisor feedback (S. del Rey)},
  decision = {All AutoScout24 \texttt{ES} listings are held out of training, validation, and calibration and replayed in M6 as a new market.
The DataMarket sample of Spanish cars is dropped.
The holdout is selected per listing, and the \texttt{split} stage reports any seller that also lists outside \texttt{ES}.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item DataMarket as a stress test on the shared makes: market, year, portal, and brand mix shift together, so an alarm could not be attributed, and it has no licence file.
\item Holding out whole sellers that touch \texttt{ES}: puts non-Spanish rows into the holdout and gains nothing, since no seller crosses the border in the real snapshot.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The supervisor asked whether DataMarket is feasible as a new market.
It is not: 36.5\,\% of its rows are makes the model never sees.
Spain is already in our data with 8,015 raw listings, same schema and scrape date, and every listing has a price, so M6 can show input drift and the error it causes.},
  ai = {Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {The options came from our own feasibility check.
AI compared them against the M6 rubric and recommended \texttt{ES} over \texttt{IT}, which would cost about three times the rows.
We accepted because it answers the supervisor's concern with evidence and keeps one data source.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-22 on project brief section 3.2.},
